source.edition: Rugby League Project, the 1961 NSWRFL premiership
source.label: NSWRFL (computed)

conversion.formula: Players: everyone the Rugby League Project lists as taking the field in the NSWRFL's 1961 premiership, its finals included; his club the one he played most games for (of two as many, the first RLP lists). Position: the one he started at most that season (RLP's starts by position; the bench is no start), else in the seasons either side, then two either side; else he is left out. Value: his selections, the games he started for his club and his representative games (Tests, State of Origin or the interstate series, NSW City v Country), plus 2 for each try at today's 4 tries a team game, scaled to his season's rate (`tryRate`), per club game, the season before at half weight when he played in it. Overall: the value's mid-rank percentile among the season's players at his position, read off Rugby League 26's overalls at that position by as many of each 2025 club's best as the season's clubs carry per club (`quota`), by linear interpolation; rounded and held to 1-99. Club shift: the season's results set each club's level and how far apart the clubs play, while its players keep their order. Each club's Simple Rating System (`srs`), its regular season's margins adjusted for its opponents and a home edge by least squares, is scaled to the clubs' own spread, times the square root of the ratings' reliability (the share of their variance that is not their games' luck, `clubShift.reliability`), and turned into points of the match model's strength, the mean of its attack and its defence: divided by `clubShift.margin`, the points a game one point of strength is worth at the season's scoring, 0.9 (`matched`: the model's margin over its first order, over its game-to-game spread against the real game's) times the first order, 2 x 0.14 x its tries a team game (`tries`) x a try's points with a conversion at 75.5% (`tryPoints` + 1.51). Added to the built-in 2025 NRL clubs' mean model strength (`clubShift.mean`), that is its target. Every player of the club moves by a whole number (`shift`) and its `plus` best players (overall, then value) by one more, held to 1-99, whichever brings its matchday 17's model strength nearest the target (of two as near, the smaller move).
conversion.metric: selections (club starts and representative games) and tries a club game, the previous season at half weight

clubShift.note: Each club's `team`: its regular season's Simple Rating System (`srs`, points a game, home edge `homeEdge`, the margins' spread about it `sigma`), its target (`mean` + `scale` x srs, `scale` = the square root of `reliability` over `margin`), its model strength (the mean of the match model's attack and defence) unmoved (`strength`) and moved (`shifted`), the move (every player `shift`, its `plus` best one more; each player's row ends with his own), and the moved matchday 17's rating (`rating`, the season's strength as shown). `reference`: the built-in 2025 clubs' model strengths.

columns: previous season [games, clubs (season/code), [starts, representative games, tries]]
shift (his club's, or one more for its `plus` best)
